name: Primary End Users
description: Individuals who use the agent to view, create, update, and delete their Google Calendar events

name: Event Participants/Attendees
description: People invited to events whose data is processed and who receive confirmations

name: Calendar Owners
description: Users whose calendars are being managed directly by the agent

name: Delegated Calendar Users
description: Assistants or colleagues with delegated access who interact with others’ calendars

name: Team Managers/Project Coordinators
description: Users scheduling team meetings and resolving conflicts across multiple calendars

name: Executive Assistants/Schedulers
description: Staff who manage executives’ calendars and coordinate complex schedules

name: Sales/Customer Success Representatives
description: Users scheduling client meetings and follow-ups via the agent

name: HR/Recruiters
description: Users coordinating interviews and candidate meetings using calendar workflows

name: Event Organizers
description: Users planning events requiring invitations, logistics, and confirmations

name: External Guests/Clients
description: Non-organization participants receiving invites and email confirmations

name: Users with Disabilities
description: End users requiring accessible agent interfaces and outputs

name: International Users
description: Users across time zones and locales needing correct date/time and localization handling

name: Google Calendar API (Google)
description: Platform providing calendar data and operations the agent depends on

name: Google Workspace Administrators
description: Domain admins managing API access, OAuth scopes, and security policies

name: Google Account Owners
description: Individuals granting OAuth permissions to the agent for calendar access

name: Google OAuth/Verification Team
description: Google reviewers approving OAuth consent screens and scopes

name: Email Service Providers (e.g., Gmail/SMTP)
description: Services used to send confirmation emails to participants

name: Email Recipients’ Mail Providers
description: External email systems that deliver or filter the agent’s emails

name: Spam/Abuse Detection Systems
description: Filters and systems that may block or flag automated emails

name: Weather Data Provider
description: Third-party service returning weather forecasts for event locations and dates

name: Video Conferencing Providers (e.g., Zoom/Meet/Teams)
description: Services whose links may be embedded in events

name: Time Zone Database Maintainers (IANA tz)
description: Providers of canonical time zone data used for scheduling accuracy

name: Identity and Access Management (SSO) Providers
description: Systems used to authenticate users and manage access to the agent

name: End-User IT Departments/Helpdesk
description: Internal teams supporting configuration, access, and troubleshooting

name: Customer Support/Service Desk
description: Agent operator’s support staff responding to user issues and questions

name: Technical Writers/Documentation Authors
description: People producing user guides, FAQs, and integration docs

name: Onboarding/Training Teams
description: Staff who train users on effective and compliant agent usage

name: Product Managers
description: Owners of roadmap, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment for the agent

name: UX/UI Designers
description: Designers ensuring usability, accessibility, and user satisfaction

name: Software Engineers/Developers
description: Builders of the agent, tools, and integrations with external APIs

name: QA/Test Engineers
description: Testers verifying functionality, reliability, and regression prevention

name: DevOps/SRE Engineers
description: Operators maintaining availability, performance, CI/CD, and incident response

name: Observability/Monitoring Teams
description: Owners of logging, metrics, and alerting for the agent’s services

name: Data/Analytics Teams
description: Analysts using product data to improve features and measure usage

name: Security/InfoSec Teams
description: Stakeholders ensuring secure coding, threat modeling, and vulnerability management

name: Privacy/Data Protection Officers
description: Owners of compliance with privacy laws and data subject rights

name: Compliance Officers/Auditors
description: Stakeholders ensuring SOC 2, ISO 27001, and similar control adherence

name: Legal Counsel
description: Advisors on contracts, IP, data processing, e-discovery, and liability

name: Procurement/Vendor Management
description: Teams evaluating and managing contracts with external providers

name: Finance/Billing Owners
description: Stakeholders overseeing costs for APIs, infrastructure, and subscriptions

name: Risk Management/Insurance Providers
description: Entities assessing operational and cyber risk, coverage, and claims

name: Incident Response/CSIRT
description: Teams handling security incidents, outages, and coordinated communications

name: Business Continuity/Disaster Recovery Planners
description: Stakeholders ensuring resilience and recovery plans

name: Data Governance/Stewards
description: Owners of data classification, retention, minimization, and quality

name: Backup/Archival Administrators
description: Operators of data backup, restore, and retention systems

name: Penetration Testers/Security Assessors
description: Third parties testing the agent’s security posture

name: Accessibility Auditors
description: Experts verifying compliance with accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG)

name: Localization/Internationalization Teams
description: Stakeholders managing translations and locale behavior

name: Beta Testers/Early Adopters
description: Users who trial new features and provide feedback

name: Open-Source Dependency Maintainers
description: External maintainers of libraries the agent relies on

name: Cloud Infrastructure Providers
description: Hosts of the agent’s compute, storage, and networking

name: Logging/Monitoring Vendors
description: Third-party platforms for observability, error tracking, and performance

name: API Quota/Rate-Limit Owners (Google and others)
description: Entities controlling API usage limits affecting reliability

name: Standards Bodies (IETF for iCalendar/ICS; email standards)
description: Organizations defining protocols the system uses

name: Data Protection Authorities/Regulators (e.g., EU DPAs, FTC, state AGs)
description: Regulators enforcing privacy and consumer laws

name: Users’ Works Councils/Employee Representatives
description: Bodies consulted for employee-monitoring implications

name: E-Discovery/Legal Hold Stakeholders
description: Teams ensuring preservation and retrieval of records when required

name: App Distribution Gatekeepers (e.g., Google Workspace Marketplace)
description: Reviewers approving marketplace listings

name: Ethics/AI Governance Boards
description: Stakeholders overseeing responsible AI behavior and policy compliance

name: Competitors/Market Analysts
description: External forces influencing requirements, differentiation, and roadmap

name: Environmental Stakeholders (Data Center Impact)
description: Entities concerned with the environmental footprint of hosting

name: Community/Advocacy Groups for Privacy and Accessibility
description: External voices influencing best practices and expectations

name: Participants’ Organizations/IT Policies
description: Companies whose employees are invited and whose policies affect delivery

name: Anti-Abuse/Fraud Prevention Teams
description: Stakeholders monitoring misuse, spam, and policy violations

name: End-User Families/Personal Contacts (indirect)
description: Individuals indirectly impacted by personal events and communications

name: Change Advisory Boards (Enterprise)
description: Committees approving production changes in controlled environments

name: Data Subjects (Participants’ Personal Data)
description: Individuals whose names/emails are processed by the agent

name: Subpoena/Legal Request Responders
description: Teams handling lawful requests for logs or communications

name: Quality Management/Process Owners
description: Stakeholders governing SDLC and continuous improvement

name: Training Dataset/Model Providers (for the agent)
description: Vendors supplying models or data powering recommendations
